ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are concentrated at the distal tips and along the lateral margins; the central and medial fluke regions are dominated by low-intensity contiguous black/dark-grey pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees and a deep vertical indentation relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with approximately 15 distinct peaks across the combined trailing edge; peak amplitudes vary between 5 to 15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the leading edges extending from the waterline to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally and vertically on the right lobe surface near the lateral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips; linear rake-like scarring visible on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The heavy concentration of barnacles on the extreme tips creates a unique, highly textured cap-like visual feature.
